title: Canonical compact support at an identity-open closed compactification
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $Z,X,V$ be schemes, let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $j:V\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with complementary images. Work with ordinary $A$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and their derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $i_*$ for module direct image [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image], $S=D^+(i_*)$ for its exact termwise functor, and $\iota_T:D^+(T,A)\to D(T,A)$ for the inclusion. At the identity open immersion, define $e_Z:(\mathrm{id}_Z)_!\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ using uniqueness of left adjoints to identity pullback, with the canonical identity-pullback isomorphism; extension by zero is [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. For the compactification $(\mathrm{id}_Z,i)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], compact support is $Ri_*(\mathrm{id}_Z)_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Define $q:\iota_Z\mathbin{\ggg}(D((\mathrm{id}_Z)_!)\mathbin{\ggg}Ri_*)\xrightarrow{\sim}S\mathbin{\ggg}\iota_X$ (composition written in functor order) by the termwise derived image of $e_Z$, the canonical derived identity comparison and left unitor, the exact comparison $Ri_*\cong D(i_*)$, and the compatibility of $D^+(i_*)$ with $\iota$. These specify the identity-extension and closed-compact-support identifications, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms.

def closedSupportCompactIso (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z X V : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hPair : IsCompl (Set.range i) (Set.range j)) :
    DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (Compactification.ofIsProper i) ≅
      supportClosedDerivedPlus A i j hPair ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι
lean.note: Owns the two already published plain definitions, not the closedSupportExceptionalComparison theorem. The identity extension is adjunction uniqueness; the compact-support comparison is their termwise derived composite and the canonical exact right-derived comparison.
